title: We Found a Phone Still Ringing in the Abandoned Motel #shorts #horror
description: Room 9 of the old roadside motel had no power for decades. Its phone was still ringing. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Some calls should never be answered.

lines.text: We explored the old motel off Route 9 at midnight.
It closed in nineteen eighty-one. No power since.
Then we heard it. A phone, ringing in room nine.
The door was locked from the inside.
My friend kicked it open. The ringing stopped.
The phone cord was cut. Years ago, by the rust.
On the bed, a guest book. Every name crossed out.
The last line was fresh ink. My name.
We ran. Behind us, the phone began to ring again.
That night, my own phone rang. Unknown number.
A tired voice asked, how long will you be staying?
